title: Episode About Udasi to the North

blocks.text: The poet closes the northern-travel account by saying he has only drawn forward what seemed most necessary, leaving fuller material to other tellings. (10)

The narrative then turns sharply to the Delhi emperor: under the Pathan ruler, saints and pirs are humiliated, forced into grinding labor, and the age waits for Guru Nanak to overturn that oppression. (Episode 9, 1–2)
Hindu and Muslim holy men alike appeal to the Guru as the one who can defend their dignity, while he answers with calm assurance that by the next day matters will turn in a better direction. (3–5)
